    Description
    ConvertDialog
    The "Convert" dialog: turns pasted text, a local file, or a URL — in CSV, TSV, JSON, XML, Markdown-table, YAML, or Excel (.xlsx) format — into SQL (for a choice of SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or Microsoft SQL Server), CSV, TSV, JSON, XML, an HTML table, a Markdown table, YAML, or Excel, inspired by convertcsv.com.
    FileTablePane
    Right-hand panel: sortable table of the current folder's contents.
    LeftPane
    Left-hand navigation panel: standard "places" plus user-defined bookmarked folders.
    MainController
    Glues the left places panel, the file table, the toolbar and all background services together.
    ScriptDevPane
    Tab 2 content: an AI-assisted bash script workspace split into three mouse-resizable rows — a prompt sent to an LLM (with a choice of AI backend), the resulting or hand-edited script, and a terminal-style view of running it.
